headline: Houston Stuns Top-Ranked Florida
summary: No. 8 Houston upset No. 1 Florida 86-76 in Las Vegas, and No. 12 Arizona beat No. 3 UConn. The episode also covers the Jazz's upset of the Lakers, the 76ers' 13-3 start, Alcaraz and Tiafoe at the ATP Finals, Canadiens-Devils, and tonight's Colts-Texans Thursday Night Football. It also touches on Drake Maye's injury and GTA 6's release day.
